target.title: Cap Codex session display when weekly quota is exhausted
target.body:
## Summary

- When Codex's weekly lane is exhausted (binding cap), `CodexConsumerProjection` now shows the session lane as **0% remaining** and uses the **weekly reset time** instead of a misleading 99% / 5-hour countdown.
- Aligns menu card, menu bar, icon, and widget usage rows with the existing burn-down widget semantics (`secondaryGloballyCapsPrimary`).
- Adds regression tests and screenshots documenting the upstream Codex UI mismatch.

### Upstream Codex UI (misleading)

![Codex settings still show 99% on the 5-hour limit while weekly is 0%](https://github.com/Yuxin-Qiao/CodexBar/blob/fix/codex-weekly-caps-session-display/docs/screenshots/codex-upstream-weekly-exhausted-session-misleading.png?raw=true)

### CodexBar after this fix

![CodexBar session row capped to 0% with weekly reset time](https://github.com/Yuxin-Qiao/CodexBar/blob/fix/codex-weekly-caps-session-display/docs/screenshots/codexbar-weekly-caps-session-fix.png?raw=true)

Upstream report: [openai/codex#31214](https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/31214)

## Test plan

- [x] `swift test --filter CodexConsumerProjectionTests`
- [x] `make check`
